meta: Opens, clicks and sales by campaign and flow, explained in plain language with next steps. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Email and SMS performance reports in plain language
overview: We read your email and text numbers so you do not have to. From your own tool we pull results for campaigns and automated flows, then show what earned revenue, what was ignored and what made people unsubscribe. The report explains each number in everyday words, compares it with the last period and ends with specific next steps, such as which subject to reuse or which flow to rewrite.

faq: Which tools can you report from?
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend, Brevo, Shopify Email and most others. You give us view access to the tool, and we pull the numbers ourselves.
Why are open rates less reliable now?
Mail apps can preload images, which inflates opens. We therefore focus on clicks, revenue and replies, and we mention opens only as a rough guide.
Do I have to hire you to act on the report?
No. The next steps are written so you or your team can do them. If you want us to carry them out, we can quote that work separately.
Yes. It covers the period you pick. Regular reporting is quoted as monthly care, and we can agree the price if you ask for a written quote.
